This Car Washing Booking System is a full-stack web application developed during my internship using the MERN stack
(MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js). The system allows users to book car wash services online by selecting service
types, preferred dates, and time slots through an interactive user interface.
The TravelX project is a MERN Stack-based tour booking web application that helps users explore and book travel packages
online. Users can register, browse destinations, book tour packages, manage bookings, and save favorite trips. The system
includes secure authentication, personalized dashboards, enquiry management, and an admin panel for managing packages
and bookings. The project demonstrates full-stack development using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js.
Developed a machine learning model to predict agricultural product prices based on seasonal patterns, humidity, and
regional data.The system analyzes data from different states and cities to generate accurate price forecasts.Applied AI/ML
techniques for data processing, prediction, and pattern recognition.Demonstrates skills in machine learning, data analysis,
and real-world problem solving.
 
The Vehicle Service Reminder System is a Python-based project that helps users keep track of service due dates for multiple
vehicles. It allows users to store vehicle details and service dates in a database. The system sends automatic reminders via
email or SMS before the service is due. It uses Python with Django or Flask, and MongoDB or SQLite for data storage. 
Developed a full-stack personal finance management system using the MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js,
Node.js). The application enables users to manage income and expenses, monitor budgets, categorize transactions, and
visualize financial data through interactive dashboards. Implemented secure authentication, CSV export, real-time balance
updates, and profile management.
